reasoning: resistivity depends on the length of the wire, if we cut it in half the length becomes half so resistivity also becomes half

feedback: You are right that cutting the wire makes its length half, and that changes the resistance (R = ρl/A, so each half has half the resistance). But resistivity ρ is a property of the material, like density, so it does not depend on length or area. Check: a small piece of copper and a long copper rod are both copper, so they have the same resistivity, even though their resistances differ. So the answer is A.

feedback: You are right that every appliance should work properly, but in parallel it is the voltage that is the same across each appliance, not the current. Each branch draws current according to its own resistance (I = V/R), so a 2000 W heater draws much more current than a 10 W bulb on the same mains. In series, the same current flows through all, and that is why one appliance switching off would stop all the others.

reasoning: we see everything the right way up not upside down, so the image on the retina has to be erect. and its not on a screen so virtual

A camera works the same way: its film or sensor records an inverted real image.

But that set-up belongs to Fleming's left-hand rule, which is used for motors. The right-hand rule is for generators, where the thumb gives motion and the middle finger gives the induced current. Quick check: a motor turns electrical energy into motion, so use the left hand there; a generator does the opposite, so use the right hand.

An inverted identical prism bends the colours back the other way, so they recombine into white light, which is option C. Quick check: Newton did this with two prisms and got white light again, so the second prism cannot be adding new colours.

reasoning: angle of incidence = angle of refelction. the ray makes 30 with the mirror so it reflects at 30 also

feedback: You remembered the law correctly: angle of incidence equals angle of reflection. But both angles are measured from the normal (the line perpendicular to the mirror), not from the mirror surface. Here the ray is 30° from the mirror, so the angle of incidence is 90° − 30° = 60°, and the angle of reflection is also 60°. Quick check: if a ray hits the mirror head-on along the normal, the angle of incidence is 0°, not 90°.

reasoning: diamond is very heavy and dense, more mass so light slows down 2.42 times inside it

Check this: oil is lighter than water, yet it has a higher refractive index, so light is slower in oil.
